Lets you draw Grease Pencil on a deformed mesh, and have it stick as the mesh deforms further.

How it works: similar to the hair system, it simply records the UV coordinate of the mesh where a GP point is drawn. Then there is an accompanying geonodes group that sets the position of each GP point to the 3D position corresponding to that UV coordinate. <span style="color:#777">It's so simple, and I've seen so many people ask for this functionality, and yet no one has done it yet as far as I can tell?! There are a few solutions out there but they all require you to draw on the resting position of the mesh. There was a [PR for a GP surface deform modifier](https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/pulls/124782) a couple years ago, but it fizzled out.</span>

Especially in combination with the Build modifier allows you to animate vertex groups in a very art-directible way!
